eda.decision: Keep matching rows: no true customer ID proves they are duplicate people.

decisions: No rows were deleted or imputed; duplicate-looking rows were retained because no true customer ID exists.
Corrected the known zip label typo Surburban to Suburban.
Added log1p(history), recency bands, and count of prior product interests.
Excluded treatment and outcomes from X to prevent leakage.
Fit one-hot categories on training rows only; test-only categories are ignored safely.
This dataset supports email-treatment effects, not discount-amount effects.

Sensitivity scenarios use a separate linear model and assumed label changes.

model_info.meaning: Estimated CATE for a profile, not observed individual treatment effect
